paragraphs.text:
1 Facial scar. You have a permanent -1 to your Charisma rolls.
2 Impaired arm. You have a permanent -1 to your Attack rolls
with hand-to-hand weapons.
3 Eye damage. You have a  permanent -1 to your ranged Attack
rolls.
4 Limping. You have a permanent -1 on all Escape rolls.
5 Brain damage. You have a permanent -1 to all Will and Magic
rolls.

6
Crippled arm. You lose the use of one arm. You may no
longer use weapons that require two hands. You may still
use rifles and shotguns with a -1 penalty.
